conditional_trust_metadata.tenant_id: Present exactly when tenant_admission is caller_admitted (or a future source_verified posture); an unattributed caller yields no tenant claim rather than a fabricated default.

freshness_policy.max_allowed_age_description: Client report evidence packs are generated from governed lotus-core portfolio evidence for the reporting as-of date. Analytics-enriched performance and risk sections may include live lotus-performance and lotus-risk service evidence, but those analytics dependencies are not certified domain-product dependencies until upstream producer declarations approve lotus-report as a governed consumer.

completeness_policy.completion_boundary: Core portfolio and transaction evidence can be complete under current governed consumer declarations. Analytics-enriched performance and risk evidence remains partially certified while lotus-performance and lotus-risk dependencies are watchlisted.

dependency_certification_boundary.consumer_safe_summary: Do not treat performance/risk-enriched ClientReportEvidencePack evidence as mesh-certified until lotus-performance and lotus-risk producer declarations approve lotus-report and the consumer declaration is updated.
